// What a C++ user of package k can ask of its concepts (gocpp -gp:concepts): types that satisfy
// the Go constraints, and types that do not. Compiled with g++ and clang++.
#include "gpkg/example.com/concepts/k/pkg.hpp"

#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace k = gpkg_example_dcom__concepts__k;

// A C++ type with the methods of a constraint.
struct CxxGreeter {
    gp::string Hello() const { return "cxx"_gs; }
};
struct CxxNonConst {
    gp::string Hello() { return "cxx"_gs; }
};
struct CxxWrongResult {
    int64_t Hello() const { return 1; }
};
struct CxxPtrMethod {
    static void Rename(gp::ptr<CxxPtrMethod>, gp::string) {}
};

// Number = Integer | Float: the signed integers and the floats, and the defined types over them.
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Sum<int64_t> && k::gp_sat_Sum<int8_t> && k::gp_sat_Sum<int16_t> && k::gp_sat_Sum<int32_t>);
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Sum<float> && k::gp_sat_Sum<double>);
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Sum<k::Celsius> && k::gp_sat_Sum<k::Meters>);
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Sum<int>, "C++ int is 32 bits, Go's int32");
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Sum<gp::string> && !k::gp_sat_Sum<bool> && !k::gp_sat_Sum<uint64_t> && !k::gp_sat_Sum<uint8_t>);
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Sum<gp::slice<int64_t>> && !k::gp_sat_Sum<k::Named> && !k::gp_sat_Sum<void*> && !k::gp_sat_Sum<std::string>);
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Sum<long long>, "a different C++ type from int64_t");
static_assert(k::gp_concept_Integer<k::Meters> && !k::gp_concept_Integer<double> && !k::gp_concept_Integer<k::Celsius>);
static_assert(k::gp_concept_Float<k::Celsius> && !k::gp_concept_Float<k::Meters>);

// Ordered adds ~string.
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Max<gp::string> && k::gp_sat_Max<k::Meters> && k::gp_sat_Max<double>);
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Max<k::Names> && !k::gp_sat_Max<bool> && !k::gp_sat_Max<gp::slice<gp::string>>);

// comparable.
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Eq<int64_t> && k::gp_sat_Eq<gp::string> && k::gp_sat_Eq<k::Named> && k::gp_sat_Eq<k::Wrapper>);
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Eq<gp::ptr<k::Named>> && k::gp_sat_Eq<gp::any> && k::gp_sat_Eq<k::Greeter> && k::gp_sat_Eq<std::string>);
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Eq<gp::array<int64_t, 3>>);
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Eq<gp::slice<int64_t>> && !k::gp_sat_Eq<gp::map<gp::string, int64_t>>);
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Eq<gp::func<void()>> && !k::gp_sat_Eq<k::Bag> && !k::gp_sat_Eq<gp::array<gp::slice<int64_t>, 2>>);

// A method: a value method (also through a pointer, a promoted one, an interface's).
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Greet<k::Named> && k::gp_sat_Greet<gp::ptr<k::Named>> && k::gp_sat_Greet<k::Tagged>);
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Greet<k::Wrapper> && k::gp_sat_Greet<gp::ptr<k::Wrapper>> && k::gp_sat_Greet<k::Greeter>);
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Greet<CxxGreeter> && k::gp_sat_Greet<CxxNonConst>);
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Greet<CxxWrongResult> && !k::gp_sat_Greet<int64_t> && !k::gp_sat_Greet<gp::string>);
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Greet<k::Renamer> && !k::gp_sat_Greet<k::Bag> && !k::gp_sat_Greet<k::Meters>);

// A pointer method: only in the method set of the pointer.
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Rename<gp::ptr<k::Named>> && k::gp_sat_Rename<gp::ptr<k::Wrapper>> && k::gp_sat_Rename<k::Renamer>);
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Rename<gp::ptr<CxxPtrMethod>>);
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Rename<k::Named> && !k::gp_sat_Rename<k::Wrapper> && !k::gp_sat_Rename<k::Greeter>);
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Rename<gp::ptr<k::Tagged>> && !k::gp_sat_Rename<CxxPtrMethod>);

// An interface that embeds two: both method sets.
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Both2<gp::ptr<k::Named>> && k::gp_sat_Both2<gp::ptr<k::Wrapper>> && k::gp_sat_Both2<k::Both>);
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Both2<k::Named> && !k::gp_sat_Both2<k::Greeter> && !k::gp_sat_Both2<k::Renamer>);
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Both2<gp::ptr<k::Tagged>>);

// A type set and a method together, and an anonymous constraint.
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Show<k::Tagged> && k::gp_sat_Anon<k::Tagged>);
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Show<k::Meters> && !k::gp_sat_Show<int64_t> && !k::gp_sat_Show<k::Named> && !k::gp_sat_Show<gp::string>);
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Anon<gp::string> && !k::gp_sat_Anon<k::Named>);

// ~[]E with the element type as a second type parameter.
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Len<k::Names, gp::string> && k::gp_sat_Len<gp::slice<int64_t>, int64_t>);
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Len<gp::slice<int64_t>, gp::string> && !k::gp_sat_Len<k::Names, int64_t>);
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Len<gp::string, uint8_t> && !k::gp_sat_Len<int64_t, int64_t>);

// Two type parameters, ~string | ~[]byte, any, and an unexported function.
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Conv<int8_t, double> && k::gp_sat_Conv<k::Celsius, k::Meters>);
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Conv<gp::string, int64_t> && !k::gp_sat_Conv<int64_t, uint8_t>);
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Size<gp::string> && k::gp_sat_Size<gp::slice<uint8_t>>);
static_assert(!k::gp_sat_Size<gp::slice<int64_t>> && !k::gp_sat_Size<int64_t>);
static_assert(k::gp_sat_Any<std::vector<int>> && k::gp_sat_Any<void*>);
static_assert(k::gp_sat_unexported<int8_t> && !k::gp_sat_unexported<float>);

// A requires-clause of C++ code that works with the package: the error names the constraint.
template <typename T>
    requires k::gp_sat_Sum<T>
T twice(T x) {
    return T(x + x);
}
template <typename T>
    requires k::gp_sat_Greet<T>
gp::string greet_twice(T& x) {
    return x.Hello() + x.Hello();
}

int main() {
    CxxGreeter g;
    return int(twice<int8_t>(3)) + int(twice(k::Meters(4)).gp_value()) + int(gp::len(greet_twice(g)));
}
